provenance.sampling: Hourly standard meteorological observations; MM/missing sentinel values omitted. Buoy observations are point measurements, not a gridded field.
provenance.wave_source: NOAA/NCEP North Atlantic Hurricane Wave Model archive; 2005 August significant wave-height animation. Model output is a hindcast/forecast product, not a direct observation.
provenance.surge_note: NHC Table 3 footnote c defines storm surge as water height above normal astronomical tide level; these are reported high-water/storm-surge values, not storm tide. Coordinates are approximate place locations because the table does not publish coordinates.
